page_title: BUR 0-1 LIV | Burnley v Liverpool 14/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Burnley are ruled offside.
90+5' 0 - 1 GOAL! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends the penalty high into the top right hand corner of the net.
90+5' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+4' The referee blows his whistle after Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. The advantage of a penalty kick is given to Liverpool.
90+3' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

90+3' Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.

90+2' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the bottom left corner of the goal. Martin Dubravka displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Here is a change. Jaidon Anthony is going off and Scott Parker gives the last tactical orders to Armando Broja (Burnley).
88' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
87' Today's match ends for Ibrahima Konate who will be replaced by Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool).
87' Arne Slot has decided to make a change. Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) replaces Florian Wirtz.

87' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the free kick from the edge of the box and fires the ball goalwards. The goalkeeper can stay calm as the shot sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
86' The substitution is prepared. Joe Worrall (Burnley) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lyle Foster.
85' Liverpool win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
84' An infringement by Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) results in a yellow card and as it's the second time today, he also sees a red and is dismissed by Michael Oliver.
83' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes.
80' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
80' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
79' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
77' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
75' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Conor Bradley (Liverpool), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

75' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
74' The linesman raises his flag. Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) is adjudged offside.
73' Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
72' Here's the change. Hugo Ekitike leaves the pitch and Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) comes on as a substitute.
70' Liverpool seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
68' A pass by Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
66' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
66' A pass from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is intercepted by Martin Dubravka and the move breaks down.
64' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
63' Scott Parker decides to make a substitution. Loum Tchaouna will be replaced by Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley).
63' Substitution. Florentino (Burnley) has come on for Josh Cullen.
62' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
61' Liverpool take a short corner kick.
59' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.

59' What a wonderful moment! Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) receives a perfect pass in the middle of the pitch, lines up the ball and unloads a powerful strike towards the left post. His effort fails to surprise Martin Dubravka, who makes a nice save. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
58' A great run by Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
57' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
56' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Martin Dubravka, who smothers the ball.
52' Liverpool have been given a corner kick after the ball crosses the byline.
51' A pass by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
50' The corner from Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is intercepted by Martin Dubravka.
49' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) challenges for the lofted pass into the centre of the box, but has to stretch too much and sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.

48' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
48' The corner is swung in but Liverpool can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
48' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee signals a corner kick to Liverpool.
46' Arne Slot has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Conor Bradley (Liverpool) comes on the pitch for Alexis Mac Allister.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Handball by Florian Wirtz (Liverpool).
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' One of the players from Burnley times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
44' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
42' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

42' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Liverpool are going to take it.

40' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score low in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Martin Dubravka allowed him to make a comfortable save.
38' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is coming onto the pitch as Milos Kerkez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
37' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

37' Josh Laurent (Burnley) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Burnley will take a corner.
36' Martin Dubravka comes off his line to intercept the corner from Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
36' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.

35' Hjalmar Ekdal (Burnley) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
34' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) commits a foul and Michael Oliver immediately signals a free kick.
33' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Liverpool.
32' The linesman makes the right call and Liverpool will have a corner.
31' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
31' Michael Oliver blows his whistle as Lyle Foster (Burnley) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
26' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
25' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Cody Gakpo (Liverpool). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
24' Josh Laurent (Burnley) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
22' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) for a tough tackle.
22' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
20' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
19' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
16' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
16' The foul by Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Michael Oliver.
15' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

12' The corner is swung into the six-yard box and Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) gets his head on the ball, but he is unable to keep it down and it goes miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
11' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

11' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Liverpool.
10' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.

9' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
8' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
8' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Now Liverpool have a corner.

7' A wild pass somehow finds Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.

5' Milos Kerkez picks out Cody Gakpo (Liverpool), who makes a total mess of his shot from mid-range and sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
5' A raking crossfield pass from Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
4' Liverpool control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
2' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Liverpool will take the kick-off.
Michael Oliver is the one to supervise the game today.
